theorems.statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) (a : Fin (j + 1)) (r : ℝ) (A b : Euclid P → ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → 0 < r → Continuous A → Continuous b → (∀ (s : Euclid P) (τ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => b (s + σ • g a)) (A (s + τ • g a)) τ) → ∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, A t ∂μHE[j + 1] = (∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, b (s + r • g a) ∂μHE[j]) - ∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, b (s - r • g a) ∂μHE[j]
